selection: After Warhammer 40K, by MTGJSON release order and pinned-index order within each edition: BRC, ONC, MOC, then From Cute to Brute. Already imported Starter precons are skipped. Preserve every original card regardless of legality. No substitutions or alternate-edition duplicates.
moxfieldAccess: The pinned index supplies queue links. These are verified Wizards / MTGJSON lists, not direct Moxfield exports.
normalization: Flip, Adventure and double-faced cards use their front names for source comparison and resolve to existing canonical aliases during intake; split cards retain their combined names. Full Scryfall faces are preserved in oracle.json.
